file_name: Amadeus - Idemia Public Security - Third-party questionnaire - Phase 1 consultation - 12 November 2026.pdf

questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, and specify what, if any, commercial relationship(s) your business or organisation has with Amadeus (including its subsidiary Vision-Box) and/or Idemia Public Security.

questions.section: Questions for customers or potential customers of Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Please outline which products or services you currently acquire in respect of the following categories (including any acquired from Amadeus/Vision-Box, Idemia Public Security, or other providers). In addition, in relation to each identified product or service, please provide (i) the provider, (ii) why that provider was chosen (i.e. what factors influenced the decision), and (iii) if it has a biometric component, what that component is and who the provider is if different from (i). a. Front-end border control systems (i.e. traveller-facing hardware and software deployed at the border to capture biometric data, such as automated border gates) b. Back-end border control systems (i.e. the governmental infrastructure underpinning identity verification and decision-making, e.g. the PACE system) c. Passenger (or passenger flow) facilitation solutions (such as hardware or software used for bag-drop, check-in, boarding or other parts of the traveller journey) d. Advance Passenger Information/Passenger Name Record (API/PNR) systems e. Any other products or services you acquire from Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security

questions.section: Questions for customers or potential customers of Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Describe how closely Amadeus/Vision-Box and Idemia Public Security compete (e.g. in terms of pricing, technological capability, innovation, range, service quality, or any other factors you consider relevant) in the supply of each of the products or services identified in your response to question 2 (including any biometric components).

questions.section: Questions for customers or potential customers of Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Identify any alternative suppliers of the products or services identified in your response to question 2 (including any biometric components) and describe how closely they compete with Amadeus/Vision-Box and/or Idemia Public Security’s services (e.g. in terms of pricing, technological capability, innovation, range, service quality, or any other factors you consider relevant).

questions.section: Questions for customers or potential customers of Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Do you consider any of the products or services identified in your response to question 2 (including any biometric components) which are provided by Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security to be “must-have” (i.e. there are not viable alternative suppliers for them)?

questions.section: Questions for customers or potential customers of Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Please explain the extent to which any of the products or services identified in your response to question 2 (including any biometric components) are required to integrate or interoperate with one another. Where they are required to do so, are there advantages in acquiring different products or services from the same provider (please identify which products or services and provide examples where possible)?

questions.section: Questions for customers or potential customers of Amadeus/Vision-Box or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Describe the commercial viability of your business or organisation self-supplying or sponsoring new entry or expansion into the supply in Australia of any of the products or services identified in your response to question 2 (including any biometric components).

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Amadeus (including Vision-Box) or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Please describe the products or services your business or organisation supplies that compete with products or services supplied by Amadeus-Vision-Box’s or Idemia Public Security’s products or services. Please specify which of those you currently supply to customers in Australia.

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Amadeus (including Vision-Box) or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: In relation to products or services identified in response to question 8 that you do not currently supply in Australia, has your business or organisation participated in any tender processes in the last 5 years run by Australian customers or does it intend to participate in any future tenders run by Australian customers? If not, why?

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Amadeus (including Vision-Box) or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Describe how closely, if at all, Amadeus/Vision-Box and Idemia Public Security compete (e.g. in terms of pricing, technological capability, innovation, range, service quality, or any other factors you consider relevant) in the supply of each of the products or services identified in your response to question 8 (including any biometric components).

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Amadeus (including Vision-Box) or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Identify any alternative suppliers of the products or services identified in your response to question 8 (including any biometric components) and describe how closely they compete with your business or organisation’s and Amadeus/Vision-Box’s and/or Idemia Public Security’s products or services (e.g. in terms of pricing, technological capability, innovation, range, service quality, or any other factors you consider relevant).

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Amadeus (including Vision-Box) or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: To what extent do any of the products or services supplied by your business or organisation have to be integrated or interoperable with products or services supplied by Amadeus-Vision Box or Idemia Public Security, including any products or services supplied to the Department of Home Affairs? Please describe any challenges or costs that you have experienced (or that you expect to experience in the future) in relation to any such integration or interoperability.

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Amadeus (including Vision-Box) or Idemia Public Security
questions.text: Please describe any barriers to entry or expansion (including any arising from a lack of access to key data that other suppliers own or have exclusive access to) that apply to the supply in Australia of any of the products or services identified in response to question 8.

Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition, including any views on the effect of the Acquisition on competition in Australia.
